description: Detect buying signals across TAM companies and watchlist personas. Three-phase architecture: (1) free diff-based signals from existing data (headcount growth, tech stack changes, funding rounds), (2) Apify-powered signals (job postings, LinkedIn content analysis, profile changes), and (3) post-processing with dedup, scoring, and lead status updates. Writes signals to Supabase signals table for downstream activation.
